title: Expression and purification of fused kinase from insect cells for in vitro kinase assay
protocol: Thaw DH10Bac chemically competent cells on ice.
Add 1-10 ng of pFastBac1 vector into 100 μL DH10Bac chemically competent cells.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 30 min.
Heat shock the cells at 42°C for 45 s.
Cool down the cells on ice for 2 min.
Add 900 μL SOC medium to the cells.
Incubate the cells at 37°C with shaking for 4 h.
Dilute the mixture with SOC medium at ratios of 1:10 and 1:100.
Spread 100 μL of undiluted, 1:10 dilution, and 1:100 dilution mixtures onto LB Agar plates.
Grow the cells at 37°C protected from light for at least 48 h.
Pick up a white colony from the plate.
Inoculate the colony in 1.5 mL DH10Bac cell growth medium at 37°C for 16 h.
Collect the cells by centrifugation and resuspend them in 300 μL P1 buffer.
Mix with 300 μL P2 buffer gently.
Incubate at 25°C for 2-3 min.
Neutralize pH by adding 300 μL of P3 buffer.
Gently invert the tubes 4-6 times.
Sediment the precipitate by centrifugation at 14,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully withdraw around 800 μL of supernatant (avoid disturbing the white pellet).
Mix gently with 560 μL (0.7 V) of isopropanol.
Let the mixture sit on ice for 10–20 minutes or at −18°C for 12 hours.
Collect the Bacmid DNA by centrifugation at 14,000 × g for 10–15 minutes.
Wash with 500 μL of 70% ethanol.
Desiccate the Bacmid DNA at 25°C in open air for 10 minutes or alternatively at a 37°C incubator.
Dissolve the Bacmid DNA in 40 μL TE buffer.
Seed 1 million of Sf9 cells into one well of a 6-well plate.
Allow cells to grow at 27°C incubator for at least 1–2 hours.
Replace the growth medium with 2 mL SF900-III medium containing 1.5% FBS.
Dilute 8 μL Cellfectin II reagent in 100 μL SF900-III medium without serum or antibiotics.
For each transfection, dilute 1–3 μg Bacmid DNA in 100 μL SF900-III medium without serum or antibiotics.
Combine diluted DNA and Cellfectin II and incubate at 25°C for 15 minutes.
Add the mixture to Sf9 cells dropwise.
Let the cells sit at 27°C for 3 hours.
Change the medium to regular Sf9 growth medium.
Incubate cells at 27°C for 72 hours before collecting medium containing P1 virus.
Store the P1 virus at 4°C with protection from light.
Seed 1–2 million Sf9 cells into one well of a 6-well plate and let the cells grow for 1–2 hours at 27°C.
Add 1–2 μL of P1 virus into each well and let the cells grow for 2–3 days.
Collect the medium containing P2 virus and verify the expression of intended protein in the cells with standard western blot procedure.
For large-scale virus production, seed 50–100 mL of Sf9 cells at a density of 1 million cells per mL into a 200 mL flask.
The next day, add 1/2000 volume of P2 virus and incubate for 3 days at 27°C.
Collect the P3 virus and store at 4°C for future infection.
Seed 600 mL Sf9 cells into a 2L flask at a density of 1 million cells per mL and infect with 6 mL Flag-CC-FuEE or CC-FuGV P3 virus on the next day.
Collect the cells by centrifugation at 5,000 × g for 20 minutes after infection.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 40 mL lysis buffer and incubate at 4°C for 10 minutes with agitation.
Remove the cell debris by centrifugation at 12,000 × g for 20 minutes.
Incubate the resultant cell lysate with 100 μL (bed volume) Flag M2 affinity agarose at 4°C for 2 hours with shaking.
Wash the beads with 3 changes of fresh cold lysis buffer at 4°C for 5 minutes each.
Elute bound protein by incubation with 2× Kinase storage buffer containing 200 μg/mL 3X Flag peptide at 4°C for 2 hours with shaking.
Load a small aliquot of eluted protein onto SDS-PAGE gel.
Stain the gel with Coomassie blue to determine purity and yield of Fu kinase.
Concentrate the kinase to 0.2 μg/μL in 2× kinase storage buffer using Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter with 10K cut-off.
Simultaneously reduce the concentration of Flag peptide in the sample to minimal level.
Dilute the kinase with an equal volume of glycerol.
Aliquot and flash-freeze with liquid nitrogen.
Store at -80°C.
Transform BL21 chemically competent cells with pGEX 4T-1 and pGEX 4T-1 vectors containing expression constructs for Ci/Cos2 polypeptides (CiN: aa 213–234; CiC: aa 1,222–1,240; Cos2: aa 564–585).
Inoculate single colony into 3 mL LB medium with ampicillin.
Incubate at 37°C on a shaker at 250 rpm for 16 hours.
Dilute with fresh LB medium at the ratio 1:200 (total 600 mL).
Continue incubation until OD600 reaches around 0.6.
Cool down on ice.
Induce GST/GST-fusion protein expression with 0.1 M IPTG and grow cells at 30°C for 3–4 hours.
Collect cells by centrifugation at 5,000 × g for 15 minutes.
Resuspend bacteria in 40 mL lysis/binding buffer.
Break cells with a sonicator on ice in short bursts (15 seconds on, 15 seconds off, 20 minutes total, 30%–40% output).
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant.
Incubate the supernatant with 0.5 mL glutathione Sepharose at 4°C for 16 hours with shaking.
Wash the beads three times with 1 mL of fresh lysis/binding buffer for 5 minutes at 4°C with agitation.
Elute GST/GST-fusion proteins by adding 1 mL of elution buffer and incubating at 4°C for 1-2 hours.
Collect the eluted proteins by centrifugation at 2,000 × g for 2 minutes at 4°C.
Determine protein yield and purity on a Coomassie Blue stained SDS-PAGE gel against BSA standard applied in amounts of 0.1 μg, 0.2 μg, 0.4 μg, 0.6 μg, 0.8 μg, and 1 μg per lane.
Assess the protein amount by scanning of the dry gel using Odyssey system at 700 nm wavelength.

Concentrate the protein to a final concentration of 0.5–1 mg/mL with Amicon Ultra-0.5 mL centrifugal filters with 10K cut-off, simultaneously exchanging buffer to 30 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5 and 100 mM NaCl.
Dilute concentrated proteins with an equal volume of glycerol.
Flash-freeze the diluted proteins with liquid nitrogen.
Store the flash-frozen proteins at -80°C.

Set up a 25 μL reaction mixture for each experimental point with 1× in vitro kinase buffer, using 0.1 ug of catalytically active/inactive protein of Fu kinase purified from Sf9 cells and 1 μg of GST Ci/Cos2 fragment fusion protein as substrate.
Incubate the reaction mixture at 30°C for 15-30 minutes.
Stop the reaction by adding an equal volume of 2× SDS loading buffer.
Boil the mixture for 5 minutes.
After the first step of in vitro kinase assay with Fu, add 20 μL of glutathione beads previously incubated with 2 mg/mL BSA at 4°C for 1 hour with agitation.
Incubate the mixture containing beads and substrates at 4°C with shaking for at least 1 hour to pull down GST-fusion substrates.
Wash the beads three times with 1× kinase buffer.
Use washed beads as substrate in final kinase assay with CK1.
Add equal volume of 2× SDS loading buffer to stop the reaction.
Boil the mixture for 5 minutes.
Add 5× IAA solution (10 μL) to the reaction mixture (40 μL).
Incubate the reaction mixture at dark for 15 minutes.
Load a small aliquot (5-10 μL) of reaction mixture onto an SDS-PAGE gel and transfer proteins to nitrocellulose membrane.
Block the membrane with 10 mL 1× blocking buffer at 25°C for 1 hour with constant shaking.
Incubate the membrane with 1× pIMAGO buffer supplemented with 1:1,000 pIMAGO reagent at 25°C for 1 hour.
Wash the membrane three times for 5 minutes each with 1× wash buffer.
Wash the membrane with TBST for 5 minutes.
Incubate the membrane with 1× blocking buffer supplemented with 1:1,000 Avidin-Fluor at 25°C for 1 hour.
Wash the membrane three times for 5 minutes each with TBST.
Scan the membrane with an Odyssey CLx imaging system.
Load 1–5 μL of the reaction mixture from an in vitro sequential kinase assay onto an SDS-PAGE.
Transfer proteins to a nitrocellulose membrane using standard Western blot procedure.
Block the membrane with 5% nonfat milk for 1 h at 25°C.
Incubate the membrane with Ci phospho-specific antibodies (primary, for CiN phospho antibody pS218/S220, 1:1,000; CiC phospho antibody pS1230/S1233, 1:4,000) at 25°C for 2 h with agitation.
Wash the membrane with TBST solution three times with agitation (5 min each time).
Incubate the membrane with fluorogenic donkey anti-rabbit antibody (secondary, 1:10,000) for 1 h at 25°C with shaking.
Scan the membrane by an Odyssey CLx imaging system at 700 nm wavelength.
